title: CasPINS: An Integrated Platform for Cas-Primer-Indel Analysis in Genome Editing
description: CasPINS (Cas-Primer-Indel Suite) is a comprehensive platform for CRISPR/TALEN gRNA design, primer design, and indel analysis. Features both graphical and command-line interfaces for analyzing genome editing outcomes from Sanger sequencing data.

creators.name: Your Last Name, Your First Name

notes: CasPINS was developed for comprehensive genome editing experiment design and analysis, supporting both CRISPR and TALEN systems.
references: Doench et al. (2016) Optimized sgRNA design to maximize activity and minimize off-target effects of CRISPR-Cas9. Nature Biotechnology
